messages:
olivia: opened docs PR #4970 to tidy the starter quickstart: swap the auth example to ephemeral tokens, add a tiny Docker deploy snippet, and fix sample repo links. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4970

mike: thanks! can you keep a short PKCE migration note for teams that still use it?

olivia: yep — main guide shows ephemeral for first-run, appendix has a 3-bullet migration checklist for PKCE users.

tara: CI linkcheck failing: /samples/starter -> moved to /samples/starterkit in the samples repo.

ci-bot: build failed — jobs/docs/linkcheck — 1 broken link: /samples/starter -> 404

olivia: fixed the sample path and added a note recommending pinning the sample commit SHA to avoid drift. pushed a small follow-up commit.

mike: small consistency nit: Docker snippet sets REDWOOD_API_KEY but some JS snippets use REDWOOD_KEY. which should we standardize on?

jordan: prefer REDWOOD_KEY (shorter). add a compatibility mapping table for older env names.

olivia: switched snippets to REDWOOD_KEY and added an envvars table explaining legacy names and scopes. also added a one-line Docker build arg: `--build-arg NODE_ENV=production`.

tara: added a tiny CORS troubleshooting box for local dev — includes a curl check for Access-Control-Allow-Origin. saves us support tickets.

ci-bot: linkcheck OK; docs/lint reported minor warnings: docs/quickstart-starter.md:line 88 sentence length.

mike: wording nit: change "production-ready example" to "recommended for demo/staging" to avoid implying full production endorsement.

olivia: updated wording and requested reviews from @mike and @tara.

mike: approved. :thumbsup:

tara: approved, thanks for the migration checklist.

olivia: merging after green main CI — will open a tiny docs-only PR to update the samples README with env var recommendations. thanks everyone!
